title: Replacing a session attribute notifies the displaced listener
summary: Replacing a session attribute now unbinds the displaced listener before binding its replacement. Rebinding the same object was silent.

change.description: MockHttpSession now sends an unbind event to a displaced attribute and suppresses a redundant bind when the identical instance is stored again.

notes: The public javax.servlet mock records the receiver, callback phase, session, attribute name and value. The challenge uses distinct listeners with equal application values.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-test 5.1.0.RC1. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
